errors.evidence: The vertical axis represents the number of responses, not the degree of responsibility. The degrees of responsibility (ratings 1-4) are represented by the different colored bars within each group.
In the 'Клиент/Възложител' (Client/Assignor) group, the value for rating 2 (red bar) is 4, not 5. The bar is visibly lower than the blue bar (rating 1), which is at 5.
The description fails to mention the specific context of the chart, which is about who monitors the management of construction waste on site, as stated in the title.
The description omits the total number of survey participants ('105 responses'), which is explicitly written in the top-left corner of the chart and provides essential context.
